---
title: "HDP, Růst a produktivita"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
source("~/R/scripts/utils.R")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
    fig.align = "center", fig.retina = 2, dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 300,
    fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)

kable <- function(df, col.names = NA, caption = NA) {
    knitr::kable(df, col.names = col.names, caption = caption, label = NA) |>
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                      full_width = FALSE,
                      position = "center")
}

httpgd::hgd_close()
httpgd::hgd(host = "0.0.0.0", port=8889, token = F)
```
